create_JetBlockConfig: create a JetBlockConfig dataclass instance with mode, expand_v, num_heads, head_dim, norm_eps, conv_size, dconv_generator_reduction, and dconv_implementation
create_JetNemotronConfig: create a JetNemotronConfig instance inheriting from PretrainedConfig with model_type set to jet_nemotron
get_full_attention_layer_ids: get the full attention layer ids from JetNemotronConfig by filtering layer_types for attn and swa entries
get_linear_layer_ids: get the linear layer ids from JetNemotronConfig by filtering layer_types for jet entries
get_mamba2_cache_params: get Mamba2CacheParams from JetNemotronConfig using efficient_attention_config jet block and state shape parameters
